rule_or_requirement: Pixel student training needs both real recovery directions; the TRAIN-only teacher can label states reached by fixed pixel-triggered steering pulses.
observable_information: Pixel road visibility, road center, obstacle flag, decision index, four-frame observations and inherited actions; privileged geometry only in TRAIN teacher labels.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Inject one fixed steer pulse per TRAIN arm and count only actual pulse-to-teacher handoffs with opposite-sign teacher steering.
expected_success_endpoint: 18 valid TRAIN episodes, zero invalid actions, and at least four distinct cells per arm with >=3 pulse decisions then the appropriate opposite-sign teacher action.
control: Exact bend-rebound ZIP SHA-256 8f7e87c29e92caf49db0070842dbc30f21a20ff98a3f48bf17d9599490559e49, with an unpulsed arm on each cell.
falsifier: Missing or invalid episode data, any invalid action, or fewer than four verified pulse-to-opposite-teacher transitions in either arm.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Fresh TRAIN tracks 1-3 x seeds 5160-5161, control/left/right arms per cell and immutable per-cell pixel labels.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU diagnostic capped at 1,800 seconds, two cores, 2 GiB and 2,000 decisions/episode; no reserved split or external action.
